assumptions.text: A1. The contemplated product is the replacement Presta valve core ([0140], [0180]), with later Schrader, stem-integrated OEM and kit forms ([0137], [0138], [0141]).
A2. The expiry remarks rest on the general-knowledge premise of a 20-year term from filing applied to the index priority dates; filing dates, term adjustments and maintenance status were not checked.
A3. The index was compiled for patentability and is self-described as thin; absence from this list is not evidence that a feature is clear.
A4. This list is a drafting and analysis aid, not a freedom-to-operate opinion; qualified patent counsel signs off.

open_questions.text: Q1. Where will the seat ring and core be manufactured? Process claims in the country of manufacture matter there.
Q2. Will the product be sold as a core only, as a complete tubeless valve, with an adaptor, or with sealant?
Q3. Is a Schrader-pattern or non-bicycle product planned?
Q4. For counsel: a professional FTO search with claim charts, starting with INDEX #1 against the seat ring and #2, #17, #8, #9, #10 and #4 against the valve and stem.
Q5. For counsel: legal status and family check of every index reference with a priority date after 2005.
